notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.en: Fixed the mobile sign-in and password-change layout so the form stays in place during repeated scrolling and the buttons remain reachable on short screens.
notes.zh: 修复移动端登录和修改密码页面的布局，避免反复滑动时表单位置下移，并确保小屏幕上的按钮可以滚动到并点击。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.en: New: pick your secretary's model beside the website language — Muse Spark 1.3 or DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. The refresh prompt is now an Update button, and every update shows its patch note afterwards.
notes.zh: 新增：可在网站语言旁选择秘书使用的模型（Muse Spark 1.3 或 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash）。刷新提示改为“更新”按钮，更新完成后会显示本次补丁说明。
